AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator registry entry for owner-level access across all expedition sections.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

OperatorProfile.title: OperatorProfile
OperatorProfile.description: Expedition operator profile linking an authenticated user to their active expedition section.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the operator.

operatorName.description: Display name of the expedition operator.

expeditionId.description: Slug identifier of the assigned expedition company.

expeditionName.description: Full name of the expedition carrier moving the vehicles out.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

ExpeditionConfig.title: ExpeditionConfig
ExpeditionConfig.description: Custom expedition carrier section and database user/password login account.

expeditionId.description: Unique slug identifier of the expedition or owner account.

name.description: Display name of the expedition section or owner account.

username.description: Custom database login username for this expedition or owner.

accessPin.description: Custom database login password for this expedition or owner.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

OutStockUnit.title: OutStockUnit
OutStockUnit.description: Individual unbundled vehicle out-stock record with VIN, Isuzu Type, Variant/Material Unit, Expedition Name, and real-time Out Gate timestamp.

expeditionId.description: Normalized slug identifier of the expedition section.

expeditionName.description: Expedition company moving the unit out of stock.

destination.description: Material unit / variant code or yard location.

status.description: Outbound gate status (STANDBY before gate out, OUT_GATE when moved out).

notes.description: Variant / Material Unit name (e.g. NMR L, FVM U, Traga PU, FTR S, NLR L).

workspaceId.description: Fixed yard workspace identifier for owner-level activity aggregation.

createdByUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who logged the unit.

operatorName.description: Name of the operator who logged the unit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when unit was registered.

updatedAt.description: Real-time server timestamp updated when status changes to Out Gate.

/admins/{adminId}.description: System administrator UIDs with owner-level visibility.

/operatorProfiles/{userId}.description: Expedition operator profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/expeditions/{expeditionId}.description: Custom expedition sections and database username/password login credentials.

/outStockUnits/{unitId}.description: Individual unbundled out-stock vehicle dispatch records.
